# Scott Morrison Pharmaceuticals

> > Scott Morrison is an ISO-certified pharmaceutical company specializing in cardiac, diabetic, and therapeutic medications with PCD franchise opportunities across India.

Scott Morrison offers a comprehensive portfolio of pharmaceutical products including combination therapies for hypertension, diabetes, allergies, and cardiovascular conditions. The company provides PCD (Propaganda Cum Distribution) franchise opportunities with monopoly rights across Indian states, backed by WHO-GMP and DCGI certifications.

- PCD Pharma Franchise

- [Telmisartan 40mg & Chlorthalidone 12.5mg Tablet](https://www.scottmorrison.in/product/telmisartan-40mg-chlorthalidone-12-5mg-tablet): Telmosis-CH40: ARB-diuretic combination for hypertension management
- [Clindipine Tablets IP 20mg](https://www.scottmorrison.in/product/clindipine-tablets-ip-20mg): CLINHEART 20: Calcium channel blocker for hypertension & stroke prevention
- [Rosuvastatin Calcium 20mg Tablet](https://www.scottmorrison.in/product/rosuvastatin-calcium-20mg-tablet): Rexovast-20: Statin for cholesterol management & cardiovascular health
- [Sitagliptin 100mg + Dapagliflozin 10mg + Metformin HCL SR 500mg Tablet](https://www.scottmorrison.in/product/sitagliptin-100mg-dapagliflozin-10mg-metformin-hcl-sr-500mg-tablet): ZEROSITA TRIO 500: Triple combination therapy for Type 2 diabetes control
- [Gliznorm M 80/500](https://www.scottmorrison.in/product/gliznorm-m-80-500): Gliclazide-Metformin combo for Type 2 diabetes blood sugar control
